name: Peregrinator Complex
description: An abandoned monastery infested with Crookshank Kobolds.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loot and companions are lured to the Peregrinator Complex by Corsen on the orders of Dreadfang.
timeline.quote: Corsen reveals that his family is being held hostage

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "What's in a Name? , by Michael A. Stackpole". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loot realizes his new name makes all the loot cursed and lets Dreadfang wield a sword, which kills him.
timeline.quote: Loot lets Dreadfang wield a sword from the stash, and the Crookshank leader immediately swings and stabs himself to death.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "What's in a Name? , by Michael A. Stackpole". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dreadfang lures Loot and his companions to the Peregrinator Complex, using Corsen's family as leverage.
timeline.quote: were lured there by a Crookshank Kobold broodlord named Dreadfang

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loot retrieves the armor Dreadfang wanted, since his nameless state should make him immune to the curse.
timeline.quote: Loot did as he was told and retrieved the armor.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Realizing his own name is cursed, Loot taunts Dreadfang, who attacks with the cursed sword; it turns on him and impales him.
timeline.quote: The looted sword, now cursed, turned on its user and impaled the kobold.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A complex holding a cursed treasure trove.
